app.name: Project Milepost
app.privacy_summary: Project Milepost keeps milestone records and selected media locally or in its shared app-group container, accesses Calendar and Photos only when chosen, and integrates one consent-gated Google AdMob banner using Google Limited Ads without Apple-defined cross-app tracking.
app.ads: The free release integrates one Google AdMob banner with Google UMP consent handling. Build 68 forces Google Limited Ads before SDK startup, disables publisher personalization, publisher first-party ID, and Google Mobile Ads SDK exception reporting, and blocks ad requests unless the current configuration and consent state are eligible.

notes: Canonical public website and bundled app mirror updated for the Project Milepost 1.9.2 Build 68 App Review remediation.
